You shroud a target in visible ethereal power that reacts violently to the presence of magic. For the duration of the spell, if the target casts a spell, they must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 1d12 force damage per level of spell slot spent (1d12 for cantrips) on a failure or half on a success. If the target ends their turn while concentrating on a spell, they take 1d4 force damage.
